searchText: if there are too many bugs around that, I agree that it doesn't pay off. But implementing TXCREATE in devnet-1 might show a slow down on progress to the community since you already layed out the plan. No clients have TXCREATE and the new initcode transaction type right? One advantage to txcreate in devnet-1 is with the next devnet all devnets are "shippable" as all community requested features are additive at that point.
